top_signal.title: Ecommerce & Growth Specialist between ventures, looking for short-term opportunities to learn, contribute & stay busy
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone,   I’m someone who’s spent the last 6 years hands-on in ecommerce, paid ads, conversion optimization, community building, and project management, currently between ventures after winding down my main business. Rather than sit idle, I’d love to use this time to learn something new, meet people, and contribute wherever I can.   I’m interested in exploring areas like consulting, small businesses/startups, agencies, community platforms, marketplaces, or honestly anything interesting where someone could use an extra pair of hands for a few weeks or months.   My background is in ecommerce growth, paid ads strategy, operations, and community management, I’m trilingual (English, French, Arabic), technically comfortable, a fast learner, proactive, and strong at problem-solving, communication, and getting things done without needing much hand-holding.   I’m not necessarily looking for another “ecommerce manager” title specifically. I’m genuinely open to trying something different too, even starting from scratch, as long as it’s real, hands-on work.   So if you’re a small business, founder, consultant, startup, or anyone who could use short-term remote help, I’d love to chat. And if you work in a field adjacent to mine and have advice on how someone like me could pick up hands-on experience somewhere new, I’d really appreciate that too.   Thanks :)       submitted by     /u/AltruisticProduct286       [link]       [comments]
